title: RTCP:  MCPT Floor taken invalid values when list fields are in use.
description:
In one hand, 3GPP TS 24.380 version 17.7.0, section 8.2.3.18-1: List of SSRCs field coding defines spare field length as one byte, however, the RTCP dissector uses 2 bytes.

In the other hand, section 8.2.3.22-1: List of Locations field coding of that same TS, the last paragraph indicates the following:
If the length of the sum of the set of <Location> values is not (1 + multiple of 4) bytes, then the sum shall be padded to (1 + multiple of 4) bytes. The value of the padding bytes is set to zero. The padding bytes are ignored by the receiver.

According to my interpretation, padding should only be added at the end of the list of locations and not at the end of each location entry.

Adding a padding of length `offset - start_offset` cannot be correct. If this were the correct place to handle padding, the length of the padding would be the difference between `offset - start_offset` and `mcptt_fld_len`. `offset - start_offset` is what has already been processed.

Though, in fact there should be no difference and it's a protocol error if there is. Padding, if it exists, is obtained from rounding up from `mcptt_fld_len + 1 + 1` in the higher level `dissect_rtcp_app_mcpt` function.

changed this line in [version 6 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19993/diffs?diff_id=1498826188&start_sha=f941b2ce3feab532945466f3067c39c720d6bc9c#aad4c96cd9f15981d5a698fbf133eefaa1f763a9_2714_2712)

This already determines the padding. IMO, there should be no other padding other than this. The comment in 8.2.3.21 that "The <Location length> value is a binary value and includes the value indicating the length in octets of the <Location> value except padding" and similar in 8.2.3.22 is referring to mcptt_fld_len not including this padding.
Note that the description of padding is similar to that for the Functional Alias and list of Functional Aliases fields, which do not have or need special padding handling.
If, immediately before the padding, regardless of field type, the offset has advanced less than `mcptt_fld_len`, that is either an error in the packet or incomplete dissection by the dissector.
